$comment: Copy to topology.json (git-ignored) and edit. Paths are absolute and machine-local; opencode cannot expand $HOME or env vars in permission patterns, so multi-repo runs use --dir per repository instead of external_directory grants. Every contract edge needs evidence and confidence. Missing evidence belongs in coverage.unknownEdges, never silently omitted.

repos.name: web-gateway
repos.summary: Edge router. Terminates TLS, authenticates sessions, applies rate limits, rewrites paths, and fans out to order and payment services.

repos.name: order-service
repos.summary: Order lifecycle: create, validate inventory, persist, emit order events. Owns the order database schema.

repos.name: payment-service
repos.summary: Authorises and captures payments. Strictly validates inbound order payloads and rejects unknown fields.

repos.name: web-checkout
repos.summary: Customer-facing checkout flow. Calls the gateway only; must never reach internal service routes directly.

coverage.$comment: Treat these as first-class findings, not bookkeeping. A repo listed here must not be presented as safe: absence of evidence is not evidence of absence.

unknownEdges.description: Dynamic route templates registered at runtime in order-service are not statically resolvable, so gateway rewrite rules cannot be fully linked.

coverage.notes: Service mesh routing rules (ingress annotations, virtual services) are NOT modelled. Do not treat the contract graph as complete for gateway-root-cause work.
